result.question: What were the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath assigned to guard?

readings.support: are to guard the house of the LORD

assessments.reason: The verse says they were to guard “the house of the LORD for the king”; the answer correctly identifies the object to be guarded (“the house of the LORD”) though it omits the qualifier “for the king,” which the question did not explicitly require.
